newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse seen up for third session running.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse seen up for third session running.

text.p: The Polish bourse was expected to rise for the third consecutive session, signalled by Friday's dominant buying after price-fixing and a 2.1-percent rise in the WIG 20 index in continuous trade.
Analysts said prices for some stocks were attractive after the bourse's fall from a three-year high at 18,339.4 points on February 18, which included last week's 6.1-percent drop.

They said the Dow Jones Industrial Average's Friday rise despite nervously awaited U.S. employment data meant there was no negative signal from abroad to pull down Polish stocks on Monday. -- Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
